events.title: VELTRAXX 2.0
events.shortSummary: The next evolution of Sri Shakthi's premier national-level VLSI and electronics symposium! Featuring national hardware hackathons, industry keynotes, and exciting cash prizes.
events.description: Get ready for VELTRAXX 2.0! Building upon the tremendous success of VELTRAXX'26, the second edition returns with expanded national competitive tracks: 24-Hour Silicon Hackathon, RISC-V SoC Architecture Design, Analog IC Layout Sprint, and exclusive networking with global semiconductor recruiters. Full event guidelines, schedule, and registration links will be released shortly.

events.title: VELTRAXX'26
events.shortSummary: The grand annual national-level technical symposium of the EE - VLSI Design and Technology Department featuring circuit design challenges, paper presentations, and tech expos.
events.description: VELTRAXX'26 was the flagship annual national technical fest and symposium organized by the Department of EE - VLSI Design and Technology at Sri Shakthi Institute of Engineering & Technology. The symposium brought together bright engineering minds from across the state for competitive technical challenges, RTL design competitions, project exhibitions, and guest lectures by semiconductor industry experts.

events.title: SYNOPSYS ONE CREDIT COURSE
events.shortSummary: Specialized one-credit industry certified training course on Synopsys EDA Tool Suite, covering ASIC frontend RTL synthesis, verification, and timing closure.
events.description: An intensive, credit-earning technical course conducted in partnership with Synopsys. Students underwent rigorous hands-on laboratory sessions exploring the complete Synopsys ASIC design flow: RTL synthesis with Design Compiler, logic verification using VCS, and Static Timing Analysis (STA) with PrimeTime. Participants successfully completed their industry evaluation and received academic credits.
events.prerequisites: Completed prerequisite curriculum in Digital IC Design.

schedule.topic: Digital IC Design Flow & Synthesis Constraints (.sdc, .lib)
Logic Synthesis Optimization with Synopsys Design Compiler
Functional Simulation & Code Coverage with Synopsys VCS
Static Timing Analysis (STA), Setup/Hold Slack & Sign-off Evaluation
